set.body: Objective: extend the completed version-one one-shot MVPA architecture with four scientifically distinct estimands, each expressed through existing TrialReadout/prepared-geometry, secondOrder/OperatorProgram, Gale, and MVPA fold/feature-set abstractions rather than a new execution engine. Children: signed cross-run Rayleigh, beta-free RSA, multiple-contrast/full-MANOVA canonical statistics, and constrained/probabilistic canonical models. These are extensions, not completion debt for the closed soft-LDA or canonical-effect slices. Every child must freeze its estimand and leakage contract, preserve temporal-versus-trial nuisance ownership, provide independent oracles, and pass JVM/Scala.js gates.
set.title: Epic: one-shot MVPA scientific estimand extensions
